The pressure to get funds in front of big money investors has never been greater as as everyone from high net worth investors to large pensions flock to&a;nbsp;commoditized, passive investment&a;nbsp;strategies. Harvest, a five year old fintech startup co-founded by former trader Peter Hans, is becoming a go-to place for funds to get their story in front of investors as they try to draw in new money.
Think of it as Wall Street&s;s LinkedIn. Harvest is a platform where hedge funds and asset management firms publish their commentary and research to an audience of investors, who can tailor their own accounts to receive&a;nbsp;only information from styles and strategies they&s;re interested in. The result? Harvest is helping funds get in front of the right eyes and it&s;s driving inflows for many firms.
